summary: Document the Core-to-Core pool peer API as a machine-readable contract with a generated reference and route coverage test, add the missing refresh-inventory agent command, and enforce command-kind coverage. API impact: existing contract (documentation of implemented behavior).

guide.reason: Internal Core peer contract and Controller command reference; no operator workflow changes.

api.reason: Existing contract: implemented peer routes (pool join/advertise, storage list/get/reserve/access/lock, pool VM inventory/actions, storage-cluster status/verify/proof) and the refresh-inventory command are now documented; no runtime behavior changed.

state.reason: Documentation and tests only; no durable product state.

verification.method: Contract/route coverage tests (29) pass; generator check reports all three references current; removing a peer route or command kind in memory fails the coverage tests; full Python suite and privacy test pass.
